name: Girls' Sleepover
summary: Aesthetically, the party is often themed around self-care or beauty and includes fun, girlish visuals that are more feminine than everyday life.
description: Aesthetically, the party is often themed around self-care or beauty and includes fun, girlish visuals that are more feminine than everyday life. That being said, a real sleepover can be themed around anything; this page focuses on sleepovers' depiction in media and merchandise. The image of sleepovers may also be more 2000s-oriented, as tween girl media was more popular at the time.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Friendship, coming-of-age

activities: Food-making activities, like making personal pizzas or roasting s'mores
Spa activities such as homemade face masks and manicures/pedicures
Girl talk, which is intimate conversation regarding romance, sex, and puberty
Risqué party games like Truth or Dare, Never Have I Ever, and Spin the Bottle
Normal party games like board games, charades, and social deduction games
Summoning a ghost or demon in party games like Ouija boards or Bloody Mary
